description: Two lists. with_ai: things people built with AI coding tools such as Claude Code or Codex: games, clones of known products, apps, tools. For ideas for your own or your user's work. Each has what was built, how, with which tools, what to take from it, and the author's own sentence saying AI built it. for_ai: tools, libraries, skills and plugins for working with AI models and agents, such as a memory layer, an agent framework or a set of skills. Each has what it does, how it is used, what it works with, when to use it, and the author's own sentence on what it is for. Newest first. What a project does, and that AI built it, are its author's claims; nobody tested it.

kind.description: Only this kind of project. clone rebuilds or replaces a known product. library, skill, plugin and learning are on for_ai only.

list.description: Only this list. Without it, both.
